recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Berry Cottage Cheese Ice Cream

items.i: coconut or dark chocolate, to top (optional)

steps: Blend the cottage cheese, blueberries, raspberries and honey until completely smooth and liquid.
Pour into a medium freezer-safe bowl or container, spread it out evenly and freeze for at least 1½ hours.
Let it sit at room temperature for 10 minutes so it's easy to scoop.
Scoop into bowls and top with coconut or dark chocolate if you like. Also good for breakfast or on a healthy crumble.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the video; macros are estimates. Any fruit works in place of the berries.
